answers.core: This necessitates the prevention and/or delay of packets at the PacketPeer level, before the packets can be evaluated by higher-level networking components, so this functionality cannot be achieved without modification of the core.
answers.workaround: This enhancement should be utilized during the development process of most networked programs, and does not have a convenient workaround. This proposal would implement nicely to the base packet transmission/retrieval system of Godot, to then effect all network communications.

title: Add Network Emulation features (latency, packet loss, throttling)
